name: Package Updates - Track npm - Breaking Change Alerts

nodes.name: Check npm Versions for Breaking Changes

parameters.subject: =🚨 Breaking Change Detected: {{ $json.package }} v{{ $json.latestVersion }}
parameters.html:
=

⚠️ Breaking Change Detected

Package: {{ $json.package }}

Previous version: {{ $json.previousVersion }}

New version: {{ $json.latestVersion }}

This is a major version bump (v{{ $json.prevMajor }} → v{{ $json.latestMajor }}), which typically includes breaking API changes.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { status: 'no_breaking_changes', checkedAt: new Date().toISOString() } }];

main.node: Check npm Versions for Breaking Changes

description: Checks a list of npm packages from a GitHub config file every 4 hours and emails dev-team@fulcrumapp.com when a major version breaking change is detected.
